description: This file defines the MailProcessor interface for handling email-related operations within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieving email replacements and recipients based on roles and events.

classes.name: MailProcessor
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for processing emails, including getting replacements and recipients.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Returns an array of replacement strings for email content based on email name, recipient, roles, and event.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Returns an array of AbstractRecipient objects representing email recipients based on email name, roles, and event.
